title: Positivity of the family bound
statement: For any $t>0$ and any $0<\varepsilon\leq1/2$, define $d=\lceil8t/\varepsilon\rceil$, $\theta=(\varepsilon/8)^2t^{-2}(1/9)^d$, and $k=\lceil2t/\theta\rceil$. Then $(d+1)(k+1)^d>0$.
